event_description: User successfully signs in with email and password.
User creates a new account with name, organisation, email, and password.
User clicks the sign-out button and their session ends.
User submits the forgot-password form to receive a reset link.
User switches between consumption, alerts, or details tabs on a site detail page.
User successfully saves changes to a site's details via the edit form.
User changes the date range selector on a consumption chart.
User snoozes an alert, opportunity, or insight for 24 hours.
User permanently dismisses an alert, opportunity, or insight.
User applies or removes a type filter (Alert, Opportunity, Insight) on the alerts page.
Admin successfully invites a new user to the organisation.
Admin permanently deletes a user from the organisation.
